message.content:
Based on the screenshot, the surface shown is a **provider accounts panel** (specifically the "Provider accounts" tab within the task view).

**Main Heading:**
Your provider accounts

**Guidance/Status Text:**
*   **Panel description:** Accounts you connect let Flauz run tasks with your provider quota. Flauz says whose account a task uses, and tells you before it uses a paid account.
*   **Status message inside the box:** No provider accounts connected yet
*   **Instructional text:** Connect an account you already have — for example an OpenAI account — and Flauz can run tasks with your quota instead of a shared one. Flauz shows what is left before each run, and never spends a paid account without saying so.
*   **Bottom status line:** This task has not been set up with an account yet — it will get one when it next runs.
